## Slice S05 — Deterministic offline audience documents and verified release sets

Goal:
- Deterministic offline audience documents and verified release sets

Tasks:
- [ ] PORTABLE-DOC-T005 Deterministic offline audience documents and verified release sets
  - manifest: `task-manifests/PORTABLE-DOC-T005.yaml`
  - depends on: PORTABLE-DOC-T003, PORTABLE-DOC-T004
  - files: `scripts/amplai_docs.py`, `scripts/loopctl.py`, `.ai-team/policy/documentation.json`, `tools/amplai-loop-kit/`, `tests/ai/test_document_html.py`, `specs/012-portable-document-lifecycle/`, `.agents/skills/work/`, `.agents/skills/dev-loop/`

Acceptance:
- fixed owner source revision and selection generate deterministic HTML and registry
- generated-only guide edits fail source/output drift validation
- network-off, no-script, keyboard, print and mobile checks include malicious title and private canary fixtures
- required CDN, raw executable source or hidden private metadata blocks bundle validation
- explicit verified release-set pins bind document set/source refs; history is opt-in and unauthorized access denied
- latest cannot select an unverified commit or treat a manually maintained portal copy as authority
- audience guides retain relevant questions, command safety, version and owner without user-visible raw agent trace
- one rigid customer-report template cannot replace required runbook-specific procedures
- Source update/review and deterministic HTML build/validation run without the user needing a separate docs workflow; S08 retains final original-case closure.

Eval:
- `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/ai/test_document_html.py tests/ai/test_document_review.py`

Dependencies:
- S03
- S04
